title: Implement the Grok Bot adapter
description:
Implement the Grok Bot adapter per the shared adapter contract: discovery of its conversation store, human-message extraction with injected-content exclusion, session and project attribution, and emission of the normalized record with source grok-bot.

Done when: golden extraction tests pass on the synthetic fixtures; the adapter streams and never loads whole stores.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: BLOCKED on KDATAP-a1a9d4: the adapter needs the researched storage format and synthetic fixtures first. Implementation plan when unblocked: create src/sentiment/adapters/grok-bot.ts implementing the SentimentAdapter contract (sync discover() with SkipCounter, async-iterable extract() yielding Zod HumanMessageRecord with source "grok-bot"), streaming reads (never load whole stores), injected-content exclusion mirroring the other adapters, and a doctorGrokBot in the style of doctorClaudeCode/doctorCursor/doctorCodex. The shared record/dedup/scan-state frameworks are ready and adapter-source-agnostic.
